prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent character-group sprite for Lesson 7–8 of the established Canran learning journey map, not a complete UI.
Input images in order: Image 1 is the approved mobile journey visual master, use for warm storybook art direction only; Image 2 is the exact target character illustration style, compact proportions, line weight, softness, and polish; Image 3 is the identity and conversation/story reference for Robert and Sophie; Image 4 gives their complete outfits and body details, but its bodies are too tall for this asset.
Primary request: Draw a new COMPLETE full-body group of Robert on the LEFT and Sophie on the RIGHT, happily talking as adult new classmates. Match the very compact approximately three-head-high proportions and thick warm dark-brown contours of Image 2, with large round heads, short friendly bodies, soft dimensional shading, subtly textured warm color, simple eyebrows, smiling eyes, warm rosy cheeks. They remain recognizably adults, not children. Use Image 3 and Image 4 for identities ONLY; do not copy their tall proportions.
Robert: brown short side-parted hair, ochre/mustard cardigan open over a cream collared shirt, blue-grey long trousers and brown shoes, holding one small plain brown closed notebook at his side. No glasses, no tie, no hat. His torso turns gently toward Sophie, friendly smile.
Sophie: auburn/red-brown bobbed hair, teal blouse with rolled or softly cuffed sleeves, coral knee-length skirt, brown flat shoes. One open hand raised toward Robert in a natural friendly conversational gesture, other arm relaxed. No hat, no uniform, no teacher costume.
Composition: compact two-person group, heads at almost equal height, Robert slightly taller, both complete hands and both shoes visible, feet on a shared horizontal baseline. Maintain enough separation to read both silhouettes at a small mobile map scale, no overlapped faces. Front three-quarter view like Image 2. Prefer ONLY the two people and notebook; no furniture, platform, building, plant or environment.
Canvas: square approximately 1254x1254, centered composition, true transparent alpha background with about 8–12% transparent space on all four sides. No white, colored or checkerboard matte. Do not crop heads, hands, notebook, skirt or feet.
Constraints: Maintain Robert/Sophie clothing colors and identities from Images 3–4. Image 2 is for STYLE ONLY; do not reproduce its blue-suit man, glasses, coral-coat woman, yellow hat or red handbag. No flags, microphones, interview equipment, nationality stereotypes, job badges or professional uniforms. No text, letters, numbers, lesson label, progress stars, gold medallions, floating icons, UI, watermark, floor shadow or ground base. Transparent background only.
